cutoff.description: Timestamp: ended sessions last seen before it are pruned. null when retention is off or the clock is unusable.

headless_cutoff.description: The same for headless sessions; null when retain_headless_hours is 0 (they follow cutoff) or the clock is unusable.

id.description: Its sesshin ID, when sesshin.json could be read.

skipped_locked.description: Prunable sessions skipped because their lock was held; the next run judges them again.

file.description: The reservation's file name, in reservations/.

job.description: The stored job, case kept; null for a reservation with no job, and for an unusable one.

reason.description: stranded: no placement 120 seconds after created_at; window-gone: the backend answered without its window; expired: more than a day old; unusable: design-spec Reservations.

reservations_skipped_locked.description: The state lock was held, so no reservation was removed; the next run judges them again.
